citation.authors: Taha S, Shakhshir M, Zyoud SH

cited_by.title: Does diet cause acne? Sugar, dairy and foods linked to spots

record.design: Meta-analysis of Mediterranean diet and acne, GRADE
record.finding: Closer adherence to the Mediterranean diet was linked to less severe acne but not significantly to lower odds of developing acne, and quality of evidence was low. More vegetables were linked to lower odds of acne.
record.note: Low-quality, small; no Black population identified.
